IBM.rationale: IBM presents a moderately attractive but conditional investment case. Pillar 1 (Fundamentals): Q1 2026 showed genuine strength — revenue +9.5% YoY to $15.92B, EPS +14.3% YoY, and exceptional OCF of $5.17B (+18.3% YoY). Software grew 11% with ARR at $24.6B and $69B remaining performance obligation providing forward visibility. However, the net margin jump from 0.091 (sustained for 9 observations) to 0.156 is a single-quarter discontinuity that may not be durable — if margins revert to 9%, earnings power roughly halves. ROE's jump from 0.211 to 0.325 is similarly a single-observation artifact, not a confirmed trend. Balance sheet leverage at 3.72x D/E is heavy, though equity grew 22.7% YoY. Consulting showed signs of weakness (signings down 15.6%, 15 federal contract cancellations worth $100M), though Q1 2026 Consulting actually grew 4% YoY to $5.27B. The z17 mainframe cycle (IBM Z +51% YoY) inflates headline numbers cyclically. Pillar 2 (Valuation): PE at 20.5x is at the absolute floor of the 365-day range (20.0-51.2), and P/B at 6.66x is similarly compressed. The stock is down -20.2% over the past quarter to $231.31, -28.8% below its 365-day high. Earnings yield of 4.9% now roughly matches the 10-year Treasury at 4.41%, offering slim equity-risk premium. The cheapness is entirely conditional on sustaining the margin step-up — at the prior 9% net margin regime, PE would be 40-45x, squarely in historical range. Pillar 3 (Catalyst): FedRAMP authorization of 11 AI/automation products (April 2026) opens federal/regulated-industry routes. Management reaffirmed >5% CC revenue growth guidance and ~$1B higher YoY FCF. The Confluent integration ($11.6B) adds real-time data streaming capability. These are credible but not transformative near-term catalysts. Net assessment: IBM's franchise in hybrid cloud and enterprise AI for is defensible, and the valuation reset creates a modestly attractive entry if margins hold. But the margin discontinuity, heavy leverage, mainframe cyclicality, and consulting headwinds warrant caution. Score of +0.25 reflects mildly-to-moderately attractive fundamentals with meaningful uncertainty on margin durability.
